title: Khorovats, the Armenian art of grilling #Armenia
description:
An iconic dish of Armenian festivities, khorovats embodies a centuries-old art of grilling, blending rituals, history and conviviality. Since 2009, the town of Akhtala has hosted an annual festival in its honor.
